text:
alana: Quick sync — we need a final decision on how the control-plane expresses runtime capabilities for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Proposing a minimal "capability manifest" plus a runtime adaptor layer to translate. Thoughts?

sam: +1. Manifest + negotiation at handshake is less coupling than RPC. We hit tight coupling with RPCs before.

trent: How do we handle authz when Private Runtimes can't reach the CP for token introspection? Edgecases.

jing: Plan: manifest includes "authModes": ["keyfile","kms-proxy","oauth-proxy"]. Runtime advertises supported modes; CP picks a compatible path or applies a fallback.

alana: :thumbsup: Also needs versioned semantics. Example manifest snippet:
```json
{"manifest_version":"1.0.0","capabilities":["streaming","kv-cache","quantized-fp4"],"authModes":["kms-proxy"],"max_seq":4096}
```

devex-lead: Please ensure SDK exposes isCompatible(manifest, requestedFeatures) so client apps can degrade gracefully.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: handshake success for env-prod-nyc at 2895017020

trent: Runtime differences — tokenizers, padding, and model-variant behavior. Should manifest include tokenizer_id and model_variant hints? Also, explicit fallback policy.

sam: Yes. Add "tokenizer_id" and "fallback_policy": ["model-variant","region-fallback","queue"]. That lets CP choose fallback deterministically.

jing: We also need a tiny canonical error code set: CP_400_INCOMPATIBLE, CP_409_CAPACITY, CP_202_DEGRADED. Map to console UX.

alana: Action items: (1) I'll draft the manifest schema PR, (2) Sam to prototype SDK check, (3) Jing to map error codes to console messaging. Any blockers?

trent: One more: metrics. Runtime should export capability_metrics like kv_hits, avg_infer_ms, token_throughput so CP routing and cost signals are possible.

devex-lead: UX note — console should show a warning when manifest lacks kv-cache but app requested it, with mitigation suggestions.

sam: I'll add unit tests for isCompatible + a small fuzzer for malformed manifests. ETA: EOD Friday.

alana: Thanks all. Filing follow-ups: GH issue #4312 and I'll link to the internal RFC. :memo:
